proposed_rules.trigger: A section-sized container with a [bg:color]/[bg:image] tag (or no tag) and no descendant text, sitting mid-page between confirmed content sections.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 extraction (image, embed, or CTA banner content) instead of treating as decorative or dropping from the block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs across C171-C173 wherever a demo video, screenshot, or closing CTA banner exists but the capture tool didn't extract descendant text/images.

provenance.evidence: C173 rc1c2c2c2 (563px, tour video), rc1c2c8c1/c2 (screenshot showcase), rc1c2c10 and rc1c2c11 (unresolved end-of-page zones)

proposed_rules.trigger: Three or more consecutive full-width [2x1] rows, each pairing a short headline+paragraph with an (uncaptured) image, alternating left/right emphasis, with no background differences between them.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as ONE 'columns' block with one row per feature (heading+text+image cell), relying on CSS to alternate left/right alignment, rather than one block per row or as three separate default-content sections.
proposed_rules.rationale: Chose a single reusable columns block over (a) treating each row as its own ad-hoc section/default-content, which would lose the repeating-component signal, and (b) a bespoke 'feature-row' block type distinct from the generic EDS 'columns' block, which would add an unneeded block type when the standard columns block already covers image+text alternation.

provenance.evidence: C173 rc1c2c5, rc1c2c6, rc1c2c7 (three consecutive [2x1] rows, Build Software Faster/Enrich Your Applications/Develop Apps with Faster Adoption)

notes: Product Tour landing page; several end-of-page zones (rc1c2c10, rc1c2c11) have no captured text and remain unresolved pending Phase 2 DOM extraction.
